   144	def get_from_archive_bulk(locator):

   146	    Gets a single binary MARC record from within an Archive.org

   148	    item.
   149	    If offset or length are `None`, then there is no next record.
   150	
   151	    :param str locator: Locator ocaid/filename:offset:length
   152	    :rtype: (str|None, int|None, int|None)
   153	    :return: (Binary MARC data, Next record offset, Next record length)
   154	    """
   155	    if locator.startswith('marc:'):
   156	        locator = locator[5:]
   157	    filename, offset, length = locator.split (":")
   158	    offset = int(offset)
   159	    length = int(length)
